statement.excerpt: From what I can tell Craiyon (formerly known as a DALL-E mini) is completely at sea on this sort of thing:
statement.document_title: Form, function, and the giant gulf between drawing a picture and understanding the world

from_speaker: Sketch a bicycle and label the parts that roll on the ground
Sketch a ladder and label one of the parts you stand on
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that contemporary Craiyon consistently struggled with these part-and-function tasks. The qualification limits confidence but does not remove the observable claim.
Completely at sea is read as substantial, repeated failure, rather than a mathematical claim of zero successes on every possible prompt.
The target is the September 2022 version discussed in the post. The latest observation window is September 1 through September 18.
Failure to render labels alone does not establish absence of knowledge about object functions.
criteria.support_condition: Independent inspection of relevant September 2022 Craiyon outputs shows repeated failure to identify and mark the requested functional parts across the bicycle, ladder, and comparable prompts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable September 2022 Craiyon outputs reliably identify and mark the requested parts across these tasks.
